{{Quote|The surprise coup attempt by Admiral Zaarin, former head of research and development for starfighter technology, has left Imperial forces on the defensive. His inside knowledge of the Empire's key military industrial facilities leave them extremely vulnerable to attack.|Imperial officer|<ref name="SWTIE">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''Zaarin insurrection''' was a conflict that raged during [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] when [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin's fleet|forces]] seceded from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and began harassing it militarily as a [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]]. They fought the Empire mainly in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and had dealings with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], though remained independent of them. Zaarin led breakthroughs in [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] fighter research, and thus used [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] and [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s, more advanced than most fighters the loyal Navy could put up. Despite the technological advantage, they were ultimately defeated. Their defeat was largely credited to the service of [[TIE pilot]] ace [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
